frozen_equation_sequence: If neither resolved water level nor groundwater level is below PONDMX, exchange is zero.
A channel/drain medium is active only if groundwater level or resolved water level is strictly greater than ZBOTDR+0.001 cm.
If active and resolved water level <= ZBOTDR+0.001 cm, resolved drain level is ZBOTDR and open-channel wetted perimeter is WIDTHR.
If active and resolved water level > ZBOTDR+0.001 cm, resolved drain level is the water level and open-channel wetted perimeter is WIDTHR + 2*sqrt(depth^2 + (depth/TALUDR)^2).
Raw head difference is GWL-DRAINL; add POND only when GWL>-0.1 cm.
For negative raw head difference with GWL<GWLINF, replace the groundwater contribution by GWLINF so effective difference is GWLINF-DRAINL.
For highest-level SWNRSRF=2, frozen extended drainage applies COFINTFL*DIFFL**EXPINTFL without a negative-side guard; D2 admits only nonnegative effective difference for this branch.
Otherwise positive effective difference uses RDRAIN/RENTRY, negative or zero effective difference uses RINFI/REXIT.
Highest-level SWNRSRF=1 positive drainage replaces RDRAIN by max(RSURFDEEP-DIFFL, RSURFSHALLOW).
For open channels q=DIFFL/(R + Rextra*LSPACING/WETPER); for tube drains q=DIFFL/R.
